user.title: Plane Radar
user.description: Sets up the Plane Radar integration. It serves the radar card at `/api/plane_radar/plane-radar-card.js` and relays ADS-B aircraft data to your dashboards. No configuration is required — add the card resource after setup (see the documentation), then drop the Plane Radar card into a dashboard.

abort.already_configured: The Plane Radar integration is already set up.
